author: Katie Morgan
body: After 10 months of having baby still wake every 2 hrs to feed I became desperate for some help. I’m so grateful to have found Andrea’s page, I quickly found her tips and suggestions easy to follow that I decided to purchase her plan. Wow! The amount of information she provided and multiple different styles of training methods I could not be more grateful for. She explains everything so well it’s easy to follow while sleep deprived. Her plans provided gentle methods for me as I was terrified and not willing to do the insanely suggested CIO method everyone and doctor seemed to only recommend. She touches on your own baby’s specific personality and understands there’s not just a one for all method to help baby sleep longer. After 3 nights we were completely sleeping all night, but even after one day I saw a difference. I was beyond skeptical about sleep training and couldn’t pull the plug on any plan for weeks maybe months, but I’m so glad I did with Baby Sleep Answers. I recommend to everyone I know with babies.
